newsitem.title: USA: Ravenswood Aluminum raises sheet and plate prices.
newsitem.headline: Ravenswood Aluminum raises sheet and plate prices.

text.p: Ravenswood Aluminum of West Virginia, 60 percent owned by Century Aluminum, the rest held by Glencore International AG, said its sheet and plate products prices have been raised.
Plate products tags rise 5 to 15 percent depending on grade. Coil and sheet products prices will increase by 3 to 10 percent.
The increase will come from the elimination of market discounts or the increase of net transaction prices, the company said in a statement.
The hikes are effective with order received on or after December 20, and will all orders scheduled to be shipped January 1, 1997 or later, regardless of order entry date.
